hero.tagline: For businesses that have outgrown their own image.

welcome.label: WELCOME TO NOOVA
welcome.heading: We build brands from the inside out.
welcome.intro: noova is a creative studio combining strategy, branding, websites, marketing and intelligent systems into one coherent practice. Every decision is connected. Every touchpoint is designed together. Nothing feels bolted on.
welcome.brandDesc: Strategy, identity and creative direction that give businesses a clear foundation.
welcome.websitesDesc: Editorial websites designed with clarity, precision and performance in mind.
welcome.growthDesc: Marketing, content and intelligent systems that help ambitious businesses grow.

founder.label: ABOUT THE FOUNDER
founder.p1: Rather than coming from a traditional design background, my path began in engineering, data science, marketing and technology. Working across startups, AI companies and growth teams taught me that most businesses don't have a design problem—they have a clarity problem.
founder.p3: Today I help ambitious businesses build brands from the inside out, bringing together strategy, identity, websites, marketing and intelligent systems into one coherent practice. Every decision is connected. Every detail has a reason.

contact.heading: Work with us.
contact.intro: Tell us about your business, your ambitions, or simply where you'd like to begin.
contact.sent: Thank you. We'll be in touch shortly.

footer.tagline: noova is a creative partner for businesses that have outgrown their own image.
footer.description: We build brands from the inside out—bringing together strategy, branding, websites, marketing and intelligent systems into one coherent practice. The result is a brand that finally matches the business behind it.

cookieBanner.title: A note on cookies
cookieBanner.body: We use essential cookies to keep the site working, and — only with your permission — a few more to understand how it's read. You stay in control. See our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> and <cookies>Cookie Policy</cookies>.

cookieModal.title: Cookie preferences
cookieModal.intro: Choose what you're comfortable with. You can change this at any time from the footer.
cookieModal.essentialDesc: Required for the site to function — remembering your choices and keeping things secure. Always on.
cookieModal.analyticsDesc: Anonymous, aggregated insight into how the site is read, so we can make it better.
cookieModal.marketingDesc: Used to measure campaigns and show relevant work across other platforms.
